description: The ordered quotient of the real plane with first-coordinate comparison is order isomorphic to the usual real line via [(x,s)] ↦ x; its inverse sends x to [(x,0)].
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.plane_quotient_order_iso :
  ∃ e,
    (∀ (p : Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.PreorderedPlane), e (toAntisymmetrization (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) p) = p.1) ∧
      ∀ (x : ℝ), e.symm x = toAntisymmetrization (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) (x, 0)
